cause: The fixture omitted mandatory control and discovery and assumed a business tool at index zero. One obsolete whole-session 404 expectation needed permission-preserving redaction assertions. After fixture repair, a genuine draft-reuse regression was reproduced: model-history trimming also limited the business reuse set.
fix: Find current-task created drafts via persisted successful receipts, independent of bounded model history; retain project/write/existence/ambiguity/purpose guards. Legacy task identity remains coalesced; independent tasks do not implicitly reuse prior named drafts.
